newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle trade slow at $70 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle trade slow at $70 - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trade was slow near midday, with light sales at $70.00 per cwt noted, steady with Tuesday, feedlot sources said.
About 1,000 head sold in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area and about 400 in Kansas, cattle feeders and USDA said.

Sales for the week to date through Wednesday morning in the Panhandle area were confirmed by USDA at 83,800 head, including 17,200 formulated cattle and 200 contracts to be shipped this week. Sales in Kansas totaled 43,500 including 6,900 head or 16 percent contracted or formulated cattle.
